text.title: Delivery team, 6 people, 10 September 2026: reset after the release
text.people: Olga, product lead: slot picker; Dmitry, mobile lead: app; Anna, QA; Ilya, analyst
text.common_goals: Slot-to-order conversion 70% by 1 November; weekly-order retention 40% by Q1 2027
text.personal_goals: Olga: own the slot picker roadmap; Dmitry: cut app start time to 2 seconds
text.values: Buyers first: a late courier is our bug; ship small and check the data
text.needs: Olga needs weekly slot data; Anna needs test devices and 2 days before each release
text.rules: Stand-up at 10:00; decisions in the Thursday review; Friday release only after QA sign-off
text.strengths: Dark-store ops know-how, 2 years of slot data, a fast mobile release pipeline
text.weaknesses: Olga: too many tests in parallel; Dmitry: decisions not written down
text.purpose: Every Moscow buyer gets their slot on time
